title: ServiceAssociation
description: Links a service to one contributing component. One record per (service, member) pair. entity_id may name a Device, a Branch (TransmissionInterface), or another Service (GroupReserve), so no member-type discriminator is needed.

service_id.description: ID of the service the membership belongs to.

entity_id.description: ID of the contributing member: a Device, a Branch, or another Service.
